fieldNotes.buildingIdentity: Confirmed via web research: 'GXO Super Hub' (GDI Construction project) at 2121 Gateway Pt, Clayton IN; GXO operates 24/7 and is hiring 2,000+ jobs in central Indiana. Satellite shows one enormous DC building (~520m x ~210m footprint, ~1.1M+ sq ft) at the geocoded point in an I-70 corridor industrial park.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck courts on the north and south faces are enclosed by continuous perimeter fencing plus retention ponds. Access is via the NE industrial-park road. A controlled gate is inferred from the fully fenced truck yard; an exact barrier arm could not be crisply resolved - imagery shows the facility newly completed and nearly empty of trailers.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth resolved at the truck-court entry. Treated as remote check-in (kiosk/app) - consistent with a newly built, highly automated GXO super-hub (Mechatronics Maintenance roles advertised).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building - dock doors with dock-door canopies and marked trailer stalls on BOTH the north face and the south face (separate dock banks on opposite faces).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band confident from continuous dock rhythm on two long faces of a ~520m building; dockDoorCount ~220 is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive marked trailer-parking stalls in both the north and south truck courts; capacity is large (50+ band, ~320 stalls estimated). Few trailers occupy them in the imagery (facility recently operational).
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Estimated 2 - the north and south truck courts each appear to have their own access; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: I-70 logistics corridor industrial park near Clayton, a small town SW of Indianapolis; site is surrounded by farmland. Small-town industrial - classified Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Very few trailers present - the super-hub is newly completed and ramping up; flagged low-confidence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box ~434m N-S x ~557m E-W ≈ 60 acres.
